evals.name: scene-notes-settings-panel
evals.prompt: Build the settings UI for a SillyTavern extension called "Scene Notes": a collapsible section in the Extensions panel with an enable toggle, a textarea for notes, a dropdown for where to inject the notes, a slider for depth 0-10 showing its value, and a Clear button that asks for confirmation first. It should look like it belongs in SillyTavern with any theme. Give me the full extension.
evals.expected_output: settings.html using ST's inline-drawer markup and native classes (checkbox_label, text_pole, menu_button), theme CSS variables instead of hard-coded colours, ids prefixed, rendered with renderExtensionTemplateAsync into #extensions_settings(2), confirmation via Popup/callGenericPopup, values persisted.
assertions: manifest.json is valid JSON with display_name, js and version
No static imports from SillyTavern internal files (uses SillyTavern.getContext() / SillyTavern.libs)
LIVE: loads in SillyTavern 1.19.0 with no extension errors in the console or Manage Extensions
Settings use ST's inline-drawer markup (inline-drawer-toggle + inline-drawer-header + inline-drawer-icon) with no custom toggle click handler
Uses ST control classes: text_pole for inputs, checkbox_label for the toggle, menu_button for the button
Extension CSS and inline styles contain no hard-coded colours (only CSS variables)
Clear asks for confirmation through ST's Popup/callGenericPopup, not window.confirm
The depth slider shows its current value and the value is saved
LIVE: the drawer appears in the Extensions panel and opens with ST's own toggle

evals.name: message-button-and-wand-menu
evals.prompt: Add a SillyTavern extension that puts a small button on every chat message which opens a popup with that message's token count and a Copy button, and an item in the extensions (wand) menu that opens a wider popup listing token counts for the whole chat. It has to work on phones too.
evals.expected_output: Per-message button added in ST's extraMesButtons convention with delegated handlers, wand menu item in #extensionsMenu with native markup, popups via Popup/callGenericPopup (wide option), toastr feedback, async token counting via getTokenCountAsync, mobile-friendly (no hover-only UI).
assertions: manifest.json is valid JSON with display_name, js and version
No static imports from SillyTavern internal files (uses SillyTavern.getContext() / SillyTavern.libs)
LIVE: loads in SillyTavern 1.19.0 with no extension errors in the console or Manage Extensions
Per-message button is a .mes_button inside the message buttons area, handled by one delegated click handler
Wand-menu item is in #extensionsMenu using list-group-item with an extensionsMenuExtensionButton icon
Popups use ST's Popup/callGenericPopup, with a wide/wider/large option for the whole-chat list
Nothing essential depends on :hover (usable on touch screens)
LIVE: every rendered message (including ones present before load) has the button, and clicking it opens a popup with a number
LIVE: the wand menu item exists and opens the whole-chat popup
